plain: A large inflow arriving all at once

webster.text: The act of flowing in; as an influx of light or other fluid.

example.quote: Let the influx of money be ever so great, if there be no confidence, property will sink in value, and there will be no inducement or emulation to industry.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 20, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
